articles.text: DÉGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Èi! Xǔ Gāng! Hái rènshi wǒ ma?
GERMAN STUDENT: Hey! Xǔ Gāng! Do you still remember me?
XǓ GĀNG: Ō! Shi nǐ ya! Sānnián bú jiàn, nǐ háishi lǎo yàngzi! Lái Běijīng duō jiǔ le?
XǓ GĀNG: Well! It's you! It's been three years, but you still look the same! How long has it been since you came to Běijīng?
DÉGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Hā! Kàndào nǐ zhēn gāoxìng! Wǒ lái zhèr yíge duō xīngqī le. Yìzhí cānguān zhèr, cānguān nàrde, mángjíle, dōu méi néng gěi ni dǎ yíge diànhuà. Nǐ hái zài Běidà ma?

GERMAN STUDENT: Ha! It's so good to see you! It's been a week or more since I got here. I've been sightseeing all over the place all along, and haven't been able to give you a call. Are you still at Běijīng University?
XǓ GĀNG: Hái zài Běidà. Nǐde Zhōngwén yuè lái yuè bàng le ma!
XǓ GĀNG: Yes, I'm still there. Your Chinese is getting more and more fantastic!
DÉGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Bàng shénme ya? Hái bu shi mǎmahūhūde! Duì le, zài zhèr kàndào nǐ zhèng hǎo! Wǒ yǒu yíge wèntí xiǎng wèn ne, nǐ yǒu méiyou shíjiān?
GERMAN STUDENT: What's fantastic about it? It's just so-so, really! Oh yes--glad I've run into you here; I have a question I'd like to ask. Do you have time?
XǓ GĀNG: Yǒu! Nǐ yǒu shénme wèntí?
XǓ GĀNG: Yes. What's your question?
DÉGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Wǒ jìde Chángchéng jīngguòle hǎojǐge shěng, yǒu yíwàn èrqiānduō lǐ cháng.
GERMAN STUDENT: As I remember, the Great Wall passes through many provinces and is over 12,000 li long.
XǓ GĀNG: Duì ya!
XǓ GĀNG: Right!
DÉGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Chángchéng shi Zhōngguó zuì wěidàde gǔdài jiànzhù.
GERMAN STUDENT: The Great Wall is China's greatest ancient structure.
XǓ GĀNG: Duì ya! Chàbuduō shi zhèiyang.
XǓ GĀNG: Right! That's about the way it is.
DÉGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Hǎo. Nàme Qíncháode shíhour wèishénme yào xiū zhème chángde Chángchéng ne?
GERMAN STUDENT: Okay. And why did they want to build such a long Great Wall during the Qín dynasty?
XǓ GĀNG: Dāngrán shi wèile fángbèi běifāng láide qīnlüè le.
XǓ GĀNG: As a precaution against invasions from the north, of course.
DÉGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Nàme, nǐmen xiànzài wèishénme bù hǎohāorde bǎohù Chángchéng, nǐmen gǔdàide chuántǒng ne?
GERMAN STUDENT: Then why aren't you doing a good job of protecting the Great Wall, of protecting your ancient tradition?
XǓ GĀNG: Shéi shuōde? Wǒmen bú shi yìzhí zài xiū ma!
XǓ GĀNG: Says who? We've been repairing it all along, you know!
DÉGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Kěshi tīngshuō nǐmende zhèngfǔ yǐjīng juédìng zài Chángchéngde fùjìn gài yíge xiàndàihuàde fàndiàn. Rúguǒ zhēn shi nèiyangr, wǒ juéde yǒu yìdiǎnr bú tài shūfu.
GERMAN STUDENT: But I hear that your government has decided to build a modern hotel in the vicinity of the Great Wall. If that's really the case, then I feel rather bad about it.
XǓ GĀNG: Ā! Wǒ xiǎngqilai le. Zài Mùníhēide shíhou, wǒmen yǒu yícì qù cānguān yíge lǎo jiàotáng.
XǓ GĀNG: Ah! I remember. When we were in Munich, once we went to visit an old church.
DÉGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Duì le. Wǒmen zǒuguò lǎo shìzhèngfǔ ménkǒurde shíhou, kàndào nàr yǒu hěn duō hěn xiàndàihuàde fànguǎnr, yě yǒu zázhì, shūbào, huàr shénmede, zhēn ràng wǒ xīnli bù shūfu.
GERMAN STUDENT: Right. When we walked in front of the old city hall, seeing all those modern restaurants, and the magazines, books, newspapers, paintings, and so on, it really made me feel very bad.

XǓ GĀNG: Hāi, xiàndàihuàde shèhuì ma, zěnme néng méiyou xiàndàihuàde dōngxi ne? Bǐfang shuō Běijīngde Qiánménwài ba, cóngqián yǒu hěn duō xiǎo pùzi. Jiěfàng yǐhòu xiūguo hǎo duō cì, nà shi bú tài hǎo, hòulái chóngxīn gàile hěn duō dà shāngdiàn, jiù zhěngqíde duō le. Yǒu shénme bù hǎo ne?

XǓ GĀNG: Well, that's modern society, you know! How can it do without modern things? Take Qiánménwài in Běijīng, for example. It used to have a lot of little shops. After liberation, it was fixed up many times, but it still wasn't too good. Later a lot of new big stores were built, and it looked much neater. What's wrong with that?
DÉGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Hǎo le, hǎo le, wǒ tóngyì le.
GERMAN STUDENT: Okay, okay, I agree.
XǓ GĀNG: Shì ma! Nǐ kàn, zhèrde dìxíng duō yǒu yìsi, fēngjǐng duō piàoliang. Lái zhèrde rén wánr yìtiān gòu ma?
XǓ GĀNG: Sure! Look, the terrain is so interesting here, and the scenery is so beautiful. Is one day enough for the people who come here?
DÉGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Dàgài bú gòu.
GERMAN STUDENT: Probably not.
XǓ GĀNG: Jiù shì ma, yàoshi fùjìn yǒu yíge dà fàndiàn, nà duō fāngbiàn!
XǓ GĀNG: Exactly. If there were a big hotel in the vicinity, how convenient it would be!
DÉGUÓ XUÉSHENG: Hǎo le, hǎo le, wǒ tóngyì le! Zǒu, zánmen zài wǎng shàng zǒuzou.
GERMAN STUDENT: Okay, okay, I agree! Come on, let's walk on up!
XǓ GĀNG: Zǒu!
XǓ GĀNG: Let's go.
